Galaxy Digital is seeking a Site Development Associate to support data center development activities in and around Waco, Texas. This role is responsible for advancing sites through entitlement and permitting, building and maintaining relationships with municipal and county officials, negotiating with landowners, and coordinating with utilities — all in support of the company's data center development pipeline. Lead and support site entitlement efforts, including zoning, platting, land use approvals, and other local governmental approvals required to advance data center sites.

Communicate regularly and clearly with internal stakeholders — leadership, legal, engineering, and construction teams — on project status, risks, and timelines.

Travel within the Lubbock region and broader Texas market as needed to support site visits, public meetings, and landowner negotiations.

Experience in real estate development, with direct involvement in at least one completed development project from acquisition through entitlement (commercial or residential); OR equivalent experience as a landman.
Demonstrated experience entitling property and working directly with municipalities, city councils, county commissioners, or other public officials.
Comfortable and experienced presenting to public bodies, boards, and internal leadership.
Working understanding of Texas oil, gas, and mineral rights and how they can affect a real estate transaction or site.
Basic understanding of real estate purchase contracts, title, and the closing process.
Experience negotiating with landowners and/or sellers in a land acquisition context.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent the company professionally to external officials and internal stakeholders alike.
Willingness and genuine interest in learning the fundamentals of data center development.
Valid driver's license and ability to travel locally and regionally as needed.
Bonus Points:
Commercial real estate development experience strongly preferred over residential.
Prior experience acquiring or coordinating utility, building, or entrance permits.
Existing relationships with officials or staff in Waco and surrounding municipalities/counties.
Familiarity with the basics of handling title, boundary, or construction-related claims.
Background in energy, land, or infrastructure-related real estate (landman, oil & gas land experience, utility right-of-way, etc.).
NOTE:
This position is based in Waco, Texas, with regular local travel and periodic travel elsewhere in Texas to support site visits, public meetings, and landowner negotiations.

jobs.description: KEY JOB DESCRIPTION Under close supervision, the Specialist, Product Safety supports the implementation of VF product safety requirements and helps ensure finished products placed in the market comply with applicable product safety regulations, internal standards, and customer expectations. The role supports product safety execution across Apparel, Accessories, Equipment, and Footwear product categories by coordinating with internal stakeholders, vendors, factories, suppliers, and laboratories. The Specialist follows established procedures to support product safety reviews, chemical safety testing governance, corrective action follow-up, retest review, shipment disposition support, compliance documentation, and stakeholder training. The role escalates non-routine or unresolved product safety issues to the supervisor or appropriate internal stakeholders and provides factual data and observations to support continuous improvement of product safety standards and processes. PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES 1)VF Product Safety Policies & Requirements Support a) Support implementation of VF product safety policies, standards, and supporting governance documentation across Apparel, Accessories, Equipment, and Footwear product categories. b) Apply established standards and procedures to help internal stakeholders, vendors, factories, suppliers, and laboratories understand and execute product safety requirements. 2)Product Safety Review and Close-the-Loop Support a)Support product safety line reviews during development, Production Readiness Meetings, and seasonal review stages by helping identify, document, and follow up on foreseeable safety concerns. b)Track mitigation actions and follow up with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and factories to support timely closure of product safety review findings. c)Escalate unresolved, repeat, or higher-risk safety concerns in line with established governance expectations. 3)Chemical Safety Testing and RSL Execution Support a)Support chemical safety testing execution based on VF Restricted Substances List requirements and required test packages. b)Verify that testing scope, required components, and supporting information are complete before routing or reviewing results for disposition support. c)Maintain accurate testing records and status updates in applicable systems or tracking tools. 4)Factory and Supplier Facility Engagement Support a)Support factory and supplier facility engagement to understand chemical management practices and implementation of VF product safety expectations. b)Assist with documentation of facility visit observations, identified gaps, corrective actions, and follow-up status. c)Support vendor, factory, and supplier education on VF requirements using established training materials and guidance. 5)Compliance Documentation and CPSC eFiling Support a)Support preparation, review, and submission of CPSC CPSIA CPC / GCC information for eFiling using the testing platform or applicable tools. b)Verify completeness and accuracy of required compliance information in line with established procedures and shipment readiness timelines. 6)APAC Targeted Testing Program Support a)Support APAC Targeted Testing program execution, including sample coordination, testing status tracking, communication of results, and documentation of outcomes. b)Track corrective action closure for targeted testing findings and provide factual updates to support continuous improvement. 7)Training, Education, and Stakeholder Support a)Support training for internal stakeholders and external partners on product safety, chemical safety, testing requirements, and platform or process use. b)Provide clear technical guidance to support understanding and consistent execution of established product safety requirements. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) • Timeliness and accuracy of product safety review support, documentation, and close-the-loop follow-up. • Completeness and accuracy of chemical safety testing scope verification, records, and status updates. • Timeliness and quality of corrective action closure for product safety, chemical safety, and targeted testing findings. • Accuracy, completeness, and on-time support of CPSC CPSIA CPC / GCC eFiling documentation. • Timeliness of shipment support decisions and escalation of non-routine or high-risk issues. • Training coverage and stakeholder adoption of product safety requirements, testing processes, and platform procedures. • Quality of factual data, recurring issue insights, and observations provided to support standards and process improvement. QUALIFICATIONS • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Material Science, Textiles, Product Compliance, or a related field. • Equivalent experience in a substantially similar industry may be considered in lieu of a degree, based on the requirements of the role and hiring manager criteria. • One to two years of relevant experience in product safety, product stewardship, regulatory compliance, testing, quality, or a related field is preferred. • Experience working with vendors, factories, suppliers, laboratories, or cross-functional product teams is preferred. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS • Working knowledge of product safety, chemical safety testing, product stewardship, and regulatory compliance gained through education and/or relevant experience. • Knowledge of standard practices, procedures, and workflows related to product safety reviews, testing requirements, report review, corrective actions, retest support, and disposition support. • Understanding of apparel, accessories, equipment, and footwear product safety expectations, chemical safety requirements, and laboratory or supplier coordination. • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to internal and external stakeholders. • Addresses recurring issues that require fact finding, clarification, and basic analysis within established processes and policies. • Determines appropriate actions based on established guidelines, procedures, and precedent, and escalates non-routine issues when needed. • Uses prior experience and basic problem-solving skills to support corrective action follow-up and issue resolution. • Proficient Microsoft Office skills and ability to use testing platforms, tracking tools, and standard business systems. SPECIAL PHYSICAL AND/OR MENTAL REQUIREMENTS • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required for factory and supplier facility engagement. • Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones and manage multiple priorities aligned to seasonal calendars. Role Overview
Compliance plays a critical role in ensuring Coupang operates ethically, transparently, and in full alignment with applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies. As a Compliance Director/Senior Principal, you will lead and manage compliance programs across multiple domains, ensuring they are effectively embedded into the organization and executed with rigor.
This position will primarily support the Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) and Fire Safety domains and serve as a strategic partner to Environment, Health & Safety, Fire Safety Compliance, Safety Operations, Legal, Compliance Analytics, and business stakeholders. You will act as a strategic partner to business and functional leaders, driving compliance program governance, risk management, and remediation efforts while operating in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving global environment.
What You Will Do
• Develop and manage compliance programs, with an initial primary focus on the Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) and Fire Safety domain and expectations to support additional compliance domains over time including Fair Trade, HR, Product & Trade, Last Mile Logistics, Trust & Safety, AML/Sanctions, Information Security & TBA, Ethics & Anti-Corruption, and Financial Crime
• Manage 1 to 3 assigned compliance domains based on expertise, with global coverage across compliance projects
• Drive program governance by establishing timelines, tracking progress, and ensuring delivery of key compliance priorities
• Develop and maintain centralized risk tracking systems to monitor compliance gaps and remediation progress
• Ensure timely identification, escalation, and resolution of non-compliance issues across the organization
• Collaborate closely with compliance domain leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure program effectiveness and alignment
• Prepare and communicate reports, dashboards, and metrics on compliance program performance, including risk status, legal registers, monitoring activities, and compliance priorities
• Partner with senior leadership to drive remediation efforts and strengthen compliance controls
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance compliance frameworks, processes, and organizational awareness
• Promote a strong compliance culture by embedding policies, standards, and expectations across the organization
Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Industrial Engineering, Environmental Science/Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Law, or related field
• 10+ years of experience in EHS / Fire Safety, compliance, risk management, audit, or related areas
• Strong knowledge of environmental, occupational health & safety, and fire safety regulatory requirements and compliance program expectations across applicable jurisdictions
• Working knowledge of international EHS management frameworks and standards, including ISO 14001 and ISO 45001
• Strong understanding of risk assessment methodologies, incident investigation processes, corrective action management, and compliance monitoring
• Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines
• Experience developing, reviewing, or maintaining regulatory inventories, legal registers, compliance obligations registers, or similar compliance management frameworks
• Experience in compliance program management and risk assessment methodologies
• Analytical mindset with the ability to evaluate complex risks and develop practical solutions
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience supporting EHS and Fire Safety compliance programs within large-scale e-commerce, logistics, fulfillment, transportation, manufacturing, technology, or industrial organizations
• Experience conducting regulatory compliance assessments, enterprise risk assessments, site audits, monitoring reviews, root cause analyses, and remediation tracking
• Experience managing compliance programs in e-commerce, technology, or logistics environments

직무 소개
본 포지션은 글로벌 3개국 사이트에서 운영되는 500명 규모 조직의
운영 수요 예측, 인력 계획, 운영 성과관리 및 비즈니스 인사이트 체계 구축
을 담당하는 핵심 역할입니다. 현재 존재하지 않는 운영 KPI와 분석 체계를 새롭게 설계하고 정착시키며, 글로벌 리더십의 의사결정을 지원하는 전략적 역할을 수행합니다.
주요 업무
운영 수요 예측 및 인력 계획
운영 물량, 백로그, 과거 데이터 및 신규 프로젝트를 기반으로 단기·장기 수요 예측 모델 수립
분기별 인력 계획(FTE Plan) 수립 및 채용 전략 도출
물량 증가, 신규 서비스 런칭, 계절적 변동, 이직률 변화 등에 대한 시나리오 분석 수행
예측 정확도(MAPE), 예측 편향(Bias), 평균 처리시간(AHT) 예측 정확도 관리
사업 연속성 계획(BCP) 및 리스크 모델 설계
비즈니스 인사이트 및 성과 분석
운영 성과 분석 및 리더십 리뷰 자료 작성
생산성(Productivity), 활용률(Utilization), 평균 처리시간(AHT), SLA 등 핵심 운영 지표 관리
비생산 시간(NPT) 및 생산성 손실 원인 분석
운영 현황 분석을 통한 개선 과제 도출 및 의사결정 지원
운영 및 이해관계자 관리
운영 조직과 글로벌 이해관계자 간 주요 커뮤니케이션 창구 역할
Training, Quality, Operations, Tooling, Inspection 등 다양한 조직과 협업
데이터 및 리포팅 체계 구축
리더를 위한 셀프서비스 대시보드 구축
통합 운영 리포팅 체계 설계 및 운영
데이터 정확성 관리 및 분석 인프라 구축
자격요건
글로벌 환경에서 영어로 원활한 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분
운영 기획, 인력 운영 관리(WFM), 리소스 관리, 성과 분석 등 관련 분야에서 8년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분
복잡한 운영 환경에서 다양한 이해관계자의 요구사항을 조율하고 실행 가능한 계획으로 구체화한 경험이 있으신 분
데이터 기반 분석을 통해 문제를 정의하고 개선 방안을 도출하실 수 있는 분

사항
운영 KPI 및 분석 체계 구축 경험 또는 운영 개선 프로젝트 경험 있으신 분
조직 리딩 경험 있으신 분

절차
서류전형 - 전화면접 - 화상면접 – 최종 합격
전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

사항
본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

반환 정책
본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (
recruitingops@coupang.com
) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

WHAT MAKES US EPIC?
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.
Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
ANALYTICS
What We Do
Our Data & Analytics teams build powerful stories and visuals that inform the games we make, the technology we develop, and business decisions that drive Epic.
What You'll Do
This position will primarily be responsible for developing strategic insights to inform Finance and Product leadership on the Epic ecosystem. The Senior Data Scientist will work in a cross-functional team environment under the direction of the Ecosystem Director of Analytics. In addition to other responsibilities, this position will maintain the core business reporting and forecasting that the org relies on, and develop high-leverage data models to improve the efficiency of the entire Insights department.
In this role, you will
Maintain and evolve core business reporting to analyze fluctuations across our core businesses — decomposing the underlying factors and isolating the causal influence of external events and internal activations
Build, maintain, analyze, and leverage time series forecasting methods to anticipate ecosystem trends and inform Finance and Product planning
Develop and maintain core data models leveraged by the entire department, improving consistency, efficiency, and analytical leverage across teams
Perform executive deep dives on high-priority subjects relevant to the Fortnite ecosystem, translating complex analysis into clear narratives for leadership
Build a deep understanding of our products and become an expert on all analytics data collected
Take accountability for the quality of data reported by our products, and work with engineering and QA to consistently monitor and improve our data
Support users of our self-service data pipeline, helping them understand the data they are using and teaching them appropriate methods to access and summarize it
Collaborate with the ecosystem analytics team to enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization
What we're looking for
Required Qualifications:
Minimum 5-7 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or in a related field
Expertise with SQL and Python
Familiarity with time series modeling
Demonstrated skills in predictive analytics, especially within complex and high-dimensional environments
Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience delivering presentations to senior leadership, including C-suite executives
Demonstrated understanding of both contemporary video games and analytics best practices
Preferred Qualifications
:
Expertise with machine learning and PySpark
Experience with time series forecasting libraries such as Prophet
Experience developing and leveraging AI workflows
Experience with causal inference methods
Passion for the gaming industry
This role is open to multiple locations across the US (including CA, NYC, & WA).

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company.
